blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Audit (COA) has commended the Office of the President (OP) for utilizing its P4.2 billion socio-civic projects fund (SCPF) to procure hospital equipment. In its annual audit report for 2025 published on COA’s website on Tuesday, the agency said OP made total fund transfers amounting to ₱4,217,259,693.10 in calendar years 2024 and 2025, distributing it to several hospitals nationwide.
